title: Your team
headline: Your *team*
sub: Add staff, give tasks, and hand over the shift.

recap.en: Techline needs a second pair of hands.

bridge.en: The team is working. But stock is running low. Where does Ikenna restock?
bridge.pcm: Team dey work. But stock dey finish. Where Ikenna go restock?

flow.action: Shows Maryam how to use the till on a phone at the counter; Maryam copies him carefully and Ikenna nods
flow.setting: Techline Gadgets in Computer Village, Ikeja: a narrow shop with a glass display counter, shelves of plain unbranded phone boxes, a wall of chargers and cables on hooks, warm bulbs, a roll-up shutter

flow.action: Closes a box of chargers, taps her phone with a small proud smile and a nod
flow.setting: Techline Gadgets in Computer Village, Ikeja: a narrow shop with a glass display counter, shelves of plain unbranded phone boxes, a wall of chargers and cables on hooks, warm bulbs, a roll-up shutter

en: Ikenna adds Maryam to the team.
He taps Add staff.
He types her name and phone number.
She will be a shift manager.
He sends the invitation, and Taskiem messages her.
She waits until she says yes.
Then Maryam is on the Team page.
pcm: Ikenna dey add Maryam to the team.
He tap Add staff.
He type her name and phone number.
She go be shift manager.
He send the invitation, Taskiem go message her.
She go wait till she yes.
Then Maryam dey the Team page.

en: Ikenna gives Maryam a task.
He taps Give a task.
He writes it: count the chargers by two.
He chooses Maryam.
Maryam hears it in her chat.
The task shows under Everyone's.
On Maryam's phone, a task waits.
She opens Your tasks.
She counts the chargers, and taps Done.
At closing, Maryam opens the tools.
She taps Handover.
Taskiem adds up the shift.
She counts the cash drawer.
Taskiem says it is five hundred naira short.
